title: Court Deployment Tracker
subtitle: Where each piece of work stands, court by court

stages.label: Scoping
stages.description: Requirements agreed with the court, process mapped, decisions recorded.

stages.label: Design & development
stages.description: Screens designed, reviewed with users, then built and code reviewed.

stages.label: Internal testing
stages.description: Functional, regression and load testing by the delivery team.

stages.label: User testing
stages.description: Court staff and judges test with real case data and sign off.

stages.label: Deployment
stages.description: Released to production, staff trained, adoption monitored.

risks.label: On track
risks.description: Expected to hit the current target date.

risks.label: Watch
risks.description: Some slack used up. No date change yet.

risks.label: Blocked
risks.description: Waiting on a decision or dependency outside the team.
